description: Investigates the bar-anti-symmetric (Q) projection of the canonical operator-valued bowtie ⋈_K = σ_g - (h/2)·𝟙 (per PR #1139 D9 closure path + isospin-from-canonical-bowtie.md). Establishes that ⋈_K is bar-symmetric, hence Q-projection of trM(K ⋈_K K') vanishes structurally; consequently Δm_{n-p} cannot come from this projection.

involutions_distinguished.common_conflation_error: Earlier work (per verify_isospin_bar_anomaly.py audit) conflated these two involutions. PR #1139 explicitly distinguishes them.
involutions_distinguished.isospin_involution: u ↔ d swap on color sheets, q fixed

key_finding: ⋈_K = σ_g - (h/2)·𝟙 is bar-symmetric: under bar involution (q ↔ q⁻¹, h ↔ -h, σ_g ↔ σ_g⁻¹), bowtie_K(h) ↦ σ_g⁻¹ + (h/2)·𝟙 = (σ_g - h·𝟙) + (h/2)·𝟙 = σ_g - (h/2)·𝟙 = bowtie_K(h). Therefore Q(trM(closure containing ⋈_K)) = 0 structurally.
structural_implication: The 305 ppm Δm_{n-p}/M_N flavor split CANNOT come from the bar-anti-symmetric Q-projection of the canonical bowtie. The carrier must be the ISOSPIN-anti-symmetric (u ↔ d swap, q fixed) projection — a different involution. Per PR #1139 D9 closure path: regularised crystal functional + isospin-anti-symmetric residue verification on the canonical atomic braid.
verdict: NEGATIVE for bar-Q projection of ⋈_K as Δm_{n-p} carrier. Closes item 1 of the pending list with a structural finding: the bar-Q channel is empty by ⋈_K bar-symmetry. Redirects to the isospin-anti-symmetric closure path (PR #1139 D9).

verifications.Q_vanishing_in_pure_bowtie_closure: trM of pure-⋈_K closure has zero (trM − bar(trM))/2 in (2,1) irrep of H_3(q)
verifications.sigma_inverse_in_2_1: σ_g⁻¹ = σ_g - h·𝟙 verified σ_g · σ_g⁻¹ = 𝟙 for both σ_0, σ_1
